plain_description: Generate high-quality images from text descriptions with a powerful, easy-to-use web interface. This tool gives you complete control over image creation, from simple prompts to advanced techniques like inpainting, upscaling, and custom model training — all without writing code.
technical_description: Stable Diffusion web UI is a Gradio-based browser interface for Stable Diffusion image generation models. It supports txt2img and img2img pipelines, inpainting, outpainting, upscaling (ESRGAN, SwinIR, LDSR), face restoration (GFPGAN, CodeFormer), and CLIP interrogator. The application runs as a local Python server with a REST API, supports checkpoint merging, LoRA, hypernetworks, Textual Inversion embeddings, and custom script extensions. It operates on NVIDIA, AMD, Apple Silicon, Intel, and Ascend NPU hardware via command-line flags.
title: Stable Diffusion web UI
